related.title: 50G-PON：高線速不消除分光限制
related.titleEn: 50G-PON: high line rate does not remove split constraints
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學時間效率至少0.95；32組通過、64組不足；禁止為追效率直接刪除必要保護時間。 burst_schedule.csv、時間守恆與錯誤計數 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.968 與變更 0.936 time efficiency、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching efficiency minimum0.95:32 passes and64 fails; required guard time must not simply be removed to improve a ratio. burst_schedule.csv, time conservation and error counters Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.968 and changed 0.936 time efficiency, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學最差裕度需非負；128分光不能因標示50G而被批准。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching worst-case margin must be nonnegative; a50G label does not approve128-way splitting.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成1 ms輪、32突發，各1 µs保護；變更64突發，輪長不變。 名義式 (1000-32*1)/1000 = 0.968 time efficiency；變更式 (1000-64*1)/1000 = 0.936 time efficiency。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在時間軸排列突發與保護區，總長應等於1 ms；驗證最後一段未越輪界。

合成可用光預算30 dB、纖路及接頭9 dB、超額2 dB；N=32改128。 名義式 30-9-2-10*log10(32) = 3.9485 dB；變更式 30-9-2-10*log10(128) = -2.0721 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將N加倍兩次，損耗應增加約6.0206 dB；與逐次1:2級聯獨立核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic1 ms cycle with32 bursts and1 µs guard each; change to64 bursts at fixed cycle duration. Nominal (1000-32*1)/1000 = 0.968 time efficiency; changed (1000-64*1)/1000 = 0.936 time efficiency. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Lay out bursts and guards on a timeline summing to1 ms and check the last interval against the cycle boundary.

Synthetic optical allowance30 dB, path/connectors9 dB and excess2 dB; changeN from32 to128. Nominal 30-9-2-10*log10(32) = 3.9485 dB; changed 30-9-2-10*log10(128) = -2.0721 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Two doublings ofN should add about6.0206 dB loss; verify by cascading two1:2 splitters.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Grace Hopper：光切換期間的服務缺口
related.titleEn: Grace Hopper: service deficit during optical switching
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學時間效率至少0.95；32組通過、64組不足；禁止為追效率直接刪除必要保護時間。 burst_schedule.csv、時間守恆與錯誤計數 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.968 與變更 0.936 time efficiency、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching efficiency minimum0.95:32 passes and64 fails; required guard time must not simply be removed to improve a ratio. burst_schedule.csv, time conservation and error counters Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.968 and changed 0.936 time efficiency, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學無服務資料預算2 GB；0.2 s通過、1.5 s失敗；若有緩衝需另驗容量與清空時間。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching unserved-data budget2 GB:0.2 s passes and1.5 s fails; buffering requires its own capacity and drain-time validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成1 ms輪、32突發，各1 µs保護；變更64突發，輪長不變。 名義式 (1000-32*1)/1000 = 0.968 time efficiency；變更式 (1000-64*1)/1000 = 0.936 time efficiency。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在時間軸排列突發與保護區，總長應等於1 ms；驗證最後一段未越輪界。

合成流量40 Gbit/s、切換中斷0.2 s；擾動為1.5 s，暫不計緩衝，非Grace Hopper實測。 名義式 40e9*0.2/8/1e9 = 1 GB；變更式 40e9*1.5/8/1e9 = 7.5 GB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用1 ms時間格積分無服務區間的位元數，再除8轉byte；記錄十進位GB與GiB差異。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic1 ms cycle with32 bursts and1 µs guard each; change to64 bursts at fixed cycle duration. Nominal (1000-32*1)/1000 = 0.968 time efficiency; changed (1000-64*1)/1000 = 0.936 time efficiency. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Lay out bursts and guards on a timeline summing to1 ms and check the last interval against the cycle boundary.

Synthetic40 Gbit/s offered load with0.2 s interruption, changed to1.5 s; ignore buffering and do not treat these as Grace Hopper measurements. Nominal 40e9*0.2/8/1e9 = 1 GB; changed 40e9*1.5/8/1e9 = 7.5 GB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Integrate unserved bits in1 ms intervals and divide by eight; record the distinction between decimalGB andGiB.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
